user.title: Connect to minidspd
user.description: Enter the URL of a minidspd HTTP server reachable from Home Assistant.

device.title: Select a MiniDSP device
device.description: Choose the DSP to add. Run this setup again to add another device from the same daemon.

reconfigure.title: Update the minidspd connection
reconfigure.description: Enter a new daemon URL. The configured DSP must be available at the new endpoint.

error.device_not_found: The configured MiniDSP device was not found at this endpoint.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
error.no_devices: minidspd did not report any devices.

abort.already_configured: This MiniDSP device is already configured.
abort.discovery_expired: Device discovery expired. Start setup again.

volume.title: Volume range and curve
volume.description: The minimum and maximum define the scoped MiniDSP gain range. The curve controls how Home Assistant's 0–100% volume moves through that range.

data.mute_with_volume: Use 0% volume instead of hardware mute

data_description.volume_max_db: Gain sent at 100% volume. Use a safe upper limit for your system.
data_description.volume_curve_mode: Choose the simple exponent curve or tune gain independently at five fixed volume points.
data_description.mute_with_volume: Moves the volume to the configured minimum and restores it when unmuted, avoiding the MiniDSP hardware mute command.

exponent.title: Exponent curve
exponent.description: One exponent shapes the full scoped range. Values below 1 provide more gain change at the quiet end; 1 is linear.

data_description.volume_curve: Use 0.415 for the recommended logarithmic-like default or 1 for linear scaling.

five_point.title: Five-point curve
five_point.description: Set the gain at 25%, 50%, and 75%. The configured minimum and maximum supply the 0% and 100% points. The integration draws a smooth, monotonic curve through all five points.

data_description.volume_point_25_db: Must be above the minimum and below the 50% point.
data_description.volume_point_50_db: Must be between the 25% and 75% points.
data_description.volume_point_75_db: Must be above the 50% point and below the maximum.

audio_sense.title: Audio sensing
audio_sense.description: Select outputs that should expose an audio-detected binary sensor. Clear all outputs to disable audio sensing.

audio_output.title: Audio sensing for output {output}
audio_output.description: Audio above the threshold turns the sensor on immediately. At or below the threshold, or unavailable level data, turns it off only after the inactivity delay.

data_description.threshold_dbfs: Output levels above this dBFS value count as active audio.
data_description.off_delay_minutes: Minutes of continuous inactivity required before the sensor turns off.

error.invalid_audio_sense: Enter a threshold from -127 to 0 dBFS and an inactivity delay from 0 to 1440 minutes.
error.invalid_volume_profile: Minimum, curve points, and maximum must increase in that order, stay within -127 to 0 dB, and use a positive exponent.

abort.audio_sense_unavailable: Output level data is unavailable. Reload the integration and try again.

command_failed.message: The command could not be sent to the MiniDSP device.

invalid_preset.message: {preset} is not a valid MiniDSP preset.

invalid_source.message: {source} is not a valid input source for this MiniDSP device.
